principle: Use shared context to coordinate work without blocking parallel progress, while preserving explicit user approval for changes to the installable PWA set.

coordination.rule: Inspect current main, open PRs, Context Hub and the shared ledger before duplicating a capability. Claims are advisory presence signals, not locks.

installablePwas.name: Héctor OS
installablePwas.purpose: Main personal OS, chat, general controls, shared utilities and entry point.

installablePwas.name: Héctor Agent
installablePwas.purpose: Autonomous goals, task execution, approvals, activity, checkpoints and Agent controls.

installablePwas.name: Pendientes
installablePwas.rule: Do not modify for unrelated work. Work explicitly targeting Pendientes may change it normally.

sharedSurfaces.rule: Bridge, Bridge Core, Context tools and remote MCP are one shared capability layer owned by Héctor OS.
Context Hub is shared context infrastructure, not an installable PWA.

creationRules: Before creating or splitting a surface, inspect shared context and concurrent work so the decision is informed rather than accidental.
There are exactly three canonical installable PWAs unless Héctor explicitly authorizes creation of another installable PWA.
Authorization to implement a feature is not authorization to create a new installable PWA.
A new installable PWA requires approvedNewPwa=true and a non-empty approvalReason documenting the explicit user authorization.
The same change that creates a new installable PWA must update this registry with a unique path, manifest and service worker.
Never create overlapping service-worker scopes or cache ownership across PWAs.
Do not modify Pendientes for unrelated work.
Claims and shared-context records remain advisory coordination signals and must not block otherwise authorized work.
